purpose: This table provides a cleaned, deduplicated registry of global airports sourced from OurAirports, giving downstream consumers a reliable per-airport record keyed by a unique numeric id for joining against flight, route, and location datasets.
usage: Join on the id grain key for a one-row-per-airport relationship; consumers should expect nullable fields such as elevation_ft, icao_code, gps_code, local_code, home_link, wikipedia_link, and keywords and must handle nulls explicitly rather than assuming full coverage, especially for local_code and home_link which are missing in over 60% and 70% of rows respectively.
limitations: No duplicate rows were found in bronze (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) so no row-level dedupe logic was applied beyond declaring the grain; several descriptive columns remain sparsely populated (local_code 63.7% null, home_link 74.9% null, keywords 68.0% null) and were retained as-is rather than backfilled, and truncation markers in long text samples were not used to infer type or completeness.
